text2activity_extraction_model.title: Autonomous vehicle design ground truth scenario

source_units.planned_content: The autonomous vehicle consists of a perception system, a path planning module, a vehicle control module, a drive actuator, a V2X communication module, a battery management system, and an HMI, and the perception system includes LiDAR, camera, and radar sensors.
Outside the vehicle, there are a control center server that monitors the vehicle status and a charging station that charges the battery.

Upon the driver's autonomous driving activation request, the vehicle control module activates the autonomous driving mode, the HMI announces the mode transition, and the vehicle transitions from the manual driving state to the normal autonomous driving state.
In the normal autonomous driving state, the driving loop in which the perception system collects and fuses sensor data to make environment perception data repeats at a 10 Hz cycle.
The path planning module generates a driving path using the environment perception data.
The vehicle control module generates control commands from the driving path, and the drive actuator executes them.
The V2X communication module transmits the vehicle status report to the control center server, and the control center server monitors it.
The camera-based perception system detects a pedestrian ahead, and a pedestrian detection event occurs.
To avoid a collision, the vehicle control module performs emergency braking within 200 ms.
The perception system detects a LiDAR reliability degradation, and a LiDAR fault event occurs.

For safety, the vehicle control module switches to the degraded mode, transitioning from the normal autonomous driving state to the degraded autonomous driving state and limiting the speed to 30 km/h or less.
The battery management system measures the battery SoC, the SoC is confirmed to be 18%, and a low-power event of 20% or less occurs.

To secure driving range, the path planning module replans the route to the charging station, the V2X communication module requests charging, and the vehicle transitions from the degraded autonomous driving state to the charging state.
The charging station charges the vehicle, and the goal of the scenario is to arrive safely at the destination.
